text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bus returning to Tracen Academy arrived.
"Two hopes" await this autumn.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"The time has finally arrived.
Shall we let that girl go first?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first ray of hope is—
Duramente's Make Debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Needless to say, expectations are sky-high.
A victory in her debut is well within reach.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Her... Make Debut...
When I witness that, I will...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder how that would feel.
I can't even... begin to imagine...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Once that's done... I'm next...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Autumn).
The race that Air Groove-san won, too."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"If only we could run through this autumn together,
pushing each other to greater heights..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's rare to see Admire Groove
wear such a bright expression.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—If possible, I hope we can win together.
No, more than that, first I just want Duramente to make a safe debut.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove has managed... a "connection" to the future.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "orbit" is back to normal.
However...

How could this happen...
It can't be...
At least... until the time comes...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Even if I can "connect,"
I cannot "deorbit"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Breaking orbit from the future is
extremely... "EXDFF"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Alpha Lyrae and—Alpha Aquilae...
The stars are...'far away,' aren't they."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Even if you were to meet,
"you all" would...
